verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync is an official first-party paid service that encrypts the vault and all communications, with end-to-end encryption enabled by default so that 'no one — not even the Obsidian team — can access your notes,' using AES-256 encryption across devices. This directly matches the story's requirements for official cross-device sync with vendor-unreadable E2E encryption. Missing for 10: independent/third-party security audit or hands-on verification of the encryption claims beyond vendor documentation.
